london.name: London System
london.summary: An easy setup to remember: you play nearly the same moves almost every time, whatever your opponent does.

london-l01.title: The idea of the London System

london-l01-s01.text: As White, you almost always play the same structure: pawns on d4, e3 and c3, with the dark-squared bishop outside the chain on f4.

london-l01-s02.text: This is the full setup. The bishop comes out before you close the pawn chain with e3.

london-l01-s03.text: The plan: bring out the bishop, close with e3, develop the knights, castle and aim the knight at e5.

london-l01-s05.explanation: First the queen's pawn, then the bishop out, and finally e3.
